arabic_html:
إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ ۖ
وَإِن يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ
وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۞
hook:
If He helps you,
who can stop it?
translation: If Allah should aid you, no one can overcome you; but if He should forsake you, who is there that can aid you after Him? And upon Allah let the believers rely.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: victory comes from Allah alone, not from numbers or preparation — so if He supports you no one can overcome you, and the believers put their trust in Him rather than in means.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: victory comes from Allah alone, not from numbers or preparation — so if He supports you no one can overcome you, and the believers put their trust in Him rather than in means.
